title: DataExport
description: plinth.data_export_request/1, from api.data_export_request() (API_CONTRACTS §3.2; BUILD_PLAN §13; DESIGN §5b Download my data). The record of a DPDP export request (app.data_requests, kind export): ready within 24 hours (due_at = requested_at + 24 hours); the link works for 7 days and opens only after a fresh sign-in code (export-data, T53). One open request at a time: a repeat call returns it.

link_expires_at.description: Set once the file is ready; the link opens only after a fresh sign-in code.

status_line.description: "Ready by 19 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm." or "Ready. The link works until 26 Oct 2026."
